meta.title: Try to purchase a BOQ-based PR with a service PR

plan.title: Block BOQ and Service PR Purchase

steps.note: Use the Open tab where selectable PRs are available.

args.goal: select one BOQ-based purchase requisition and one service purchase requisition together, hover the disabled Purchase Items control and verify it shows the message "BOQ-based PR cannot pe purchased along with Service PR", then attempt to click Purchase Items without proceeding

steps.note: The catalog has no domain step for combining two distinct PRs or checking the resulting disabled-control tooltip.

args.text: BOQ-based PR cannot pe purchased along with Service PR

steps.note: Assert the required incompatibility message is shown for the disabled Purchase Items control.
